Problem: Buyer has workflow or product problem that off-the-shelf tools do not solve
Core Message: Build custom software around your workflow, customers, and growth plans
Distribution Channels: SEO, LinkedIn, retargeting, exact-match paid search after tracking
Required Assets: Case studies, process summary, FAQs, proof screenshots
Qualification Criteria: B2B company, defined business problem, realistic budget, decision maker or influencer
Follow Up Sequence: Form confirmation, same-day sales reply, discovery email, case-study follow-up
KPIs: Qualified leads, conversion rate, pipeline value, cost per qualified lead

Problem: Internal team lacks enough engineering capacity
Core Message: Add a focused engineering team that works with your roadmap
Distribution Channels: SEO, LinkedIn outbound, directory listings, retargeting
Required Assets: Team model, role availability, vetting process, sample onboarding plan
Qualification Criteria: Needs two or more roles or ongoing capacity, clear timeline, budget approved
Follow Up Sequence: Developer-fit email, role shortlist, consultation, proposal
KPIs: Developer requests, qualified calls, opportunity value, close rate
Risks: Page overlap with staff augmentation and team extension

Core Message: Hire experienced developers and product talent for specific needs
Distribution Channels: SEO, paid search later, LinkedIn, referral partners
Required Assets: Working form, role pages or role sections, response SLA, talent proof
Qualification Criteria: Company email, role needed, timeline, engagement model, budget or team size
Follow Up Sequence: Immediate confirmation, sales reply, talent-fit call, role proposal
KPIs: Form submissions, qualified developer requests, response time, hire conversion
Risks: Current form routing may not be real

Problem: Buyer needs a first usable product without overbuilding
Core Message: Turn a product idea into a scoped, usable first version
Distribution Channels: SEO, LinkedIn, startup communities, founder referrals
Required Assets: MVP checklist, timeline examples, scope template, product examples
Qualification Criteria: Funded or budget-ready founder, defined product idea, target launch window
Follow Up Sequence: Planning email, discovery call, scope workshop, proposal
KPIs: MVP calls, qualified opportunities, average deal value
Risks: Pricing and delivery capacity not confirmed

Problem: Releases are unstable or testing process is weak
Core Message: Improve release confidence with structured QA support
Required Assets: QA checklist, testing-methods page section, tool list, proof example
Qualification Criteria: Software product with active releases, QA need, technical owner available
Follow Up Sequence: Audit email, QA-fit call, sample test plan, proposal
KPIs: QA audit requests, qualified QA leads, pipeline value
Risks: QA methods and tools must be verified

Problem: Legacy systems, deployment risk, or cloud operations slow the business
Core Message: Reduce technical risk in systems, deployment, and infrastructure
Required Assets: Modernization checklist, DevOps proof, cloud tool list, SLA boundaries
Qualification Criteria: Existing system, modernization pain, technical stakeholder, budget path
Follow Up Sequence: Assessment email, technical call, risk summary, proposal
KPIs: Assessment requests, qualified technical leads, opportunity value
Risks: Security, compliance, and SLA claims need verification
